page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-32 is an Arm-based instance designed for memory-intensive execution environments. Built on the arm64 architecture, the server provides 32 dedicated vCPUs without hyper-threading. The instance features 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This high memory-to-vCPU ratio positions the instance above standard general-purpose baselines, providing substantial capacity for large working sets.

The n4a-highmem-32 configuration omits local storage drives and hardware accelerators, operating with 0 GPUs. All persistent filesystems, database stores, and operational files must be mounted using network-attached cloud block storage volumes. Furthermore, the instance provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on private network routing or reserved external IP addressing.

By combining dedicated 64-bit Arm execution cores with high-density memory, the instance delivers favorable resource efficiency for memory-heavy systems compared to standard configurations. A key technical tradeoff is the absence of local ephemeral NVMe storage, requiring application architects to size network storage throughput carefully. The server profile is suited for in-memory databases, Redis caches, distributed ETL processing, and enterprise application runtimes requiring significant memory capacity.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-32 is an Arm-based virtual machine configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of system memory. Operating on the 64-bit Arm architecture, this configuration maintains an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, allocating 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance contains no integrated GPUs and does not provision local storage volumes, requiring external persistent network disks for OS and application data. Networking does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The allocation of dedicated Arm vCPUs ensures predictable core access without thread contention or hyper-threading overhead. With its expanded memory capacity relative to compute cores, n4a-highmem-32 provides an efficient platform for workloads whose resource consumption centers on volatile memory rather than extreme disk I/O. Appropriate use cases include medium-to-large in-memory caching tiers, database servers, memory-bound data analytics pipelines, and memory-intensive enterprise application runtimes.
